CREATE TRIGGER trg_papers_unique_new_doi BEFORE INSERT ON papers
      WHEN COALESCE(trim(NEW.doi),'') != '' AND EXISTS
        (SELECT 1 FROM papers WHERE lower(trim(doi))=lower(trim(NEW.doi)))
      BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'DOI already belongs to a paper; resolve its identity first'); END;

CREATE TRIGGER trg_papers_unique_changed_doi BEFORE UPDATE OF doi ON papers
      WHEN COALESCE(lower(trim(NEW.doi)),'') != ''
       AND COALESCE(lower(trim(NEW.doi)),'') != COALESCE(lower(trim(OLD.doi)),'')
       AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM papers WHERE paper_id != OLD.paper_id AND lower(trim(doi))=lower(trim(NEW.doi)))
      BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'DOI already belongs to a paper; resolve its identity first'); END;

CREATE TRIGGER trg_author_monitor_card_cache_paper_insert
            AFTER INSERT ON papers
            BEGIN
              INSERT INTO author_monitor_card_cache_dirty (paper_id, revision)
              SELECT NEW.paper_id, 1
              WHERE EXISTS (
                SELECT 1 FROM author_monitor_papers
                WHERE author_monitor_papers.paper_id = NEW.paper_id
              )
              ON CONFLICT(paper_id) DO UPDATE SET revision = revision + 1;
            END;

CREATE TRIGGER trg_author_monitor_card_cache_paper_update
            AFTER UPDATE ON papers
            BEGIN
              INSERT INTO author_monitor_card_cache_dirty (paper_id, revision)
              SELECT NEW.paper_id, 1
              WHERE EXISTS (
                SELECT 1 FROM author_monitor_papers
                WHERE author_monitor_papers.paper_id = NEW.paper_id
              )
              ON CONFLICT(paper_id) DO UPDATE SET revision = revision + 1;
            END;

CREATE TRIGGER trg_author_monitor_card_cache_monitor_insert
            AFTER INSERT ON author_monitor_papers
            BEGIN
              INSERT INTO author_monitor_card_cache_dirty (paper_id, revision)
              VALUES (NEW.paper_id, 1)
              ON CONFLICT(paper_id) DO UPDATE SET revision = revision + 1;
            END;

CREATE TRIGGER resource_path_unique_insert
            BEFORE INSERT ON resources
            WHEN NEW.paper_id IS NOT NULL AND COALESCE(NEW.stored_path, '') != ''
              
              AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM resources WHERE paper_id=NEW.paper_id
                  AND stored_path=NEW.stored_path )
            BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'Duplicate Paper File path'); END;

CREATE TRIGGER resource_path_unique_update
            BEFORE UPDATE OF paper_id, stored_path ON resources
            WHEN NEW.paper_id IS NOT NULL AND COALESCE(NEW.stored_path, '') != ''
              AND (NEW.paper_id IS NOT OLD.paper_id OR NEW.stored_path IS NOT OLD.stored_path)
              AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM resources WHERE paper_id=NEW.paper_id
                  AND stored_path=NEW.stored_path AND id != NEW.id)
            BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'Duplicate Paper File path'); END;
